## R Markdown

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# rename + distribution
fi_data <- data.frame(
  variable = c("Leaving Intention", "Salary", "Unemployed Status",
               "Years Coding", "Work Experience", "Considered Career Change",
               "Feels AI is a Threat", "Tools Used at Work",
               "Tech Purchase Influence", "Dislikes AI"),
  importance = c(100, 25, 18, 13, 11, 9, 8, 7, 7, 5),
  group = c("Career", "Pay", "Career", "Experience", "Experience",
            "Career", "AI Attitude", "Other", "Other", "AI Attitude")
)

ggplot(fi_data, aes(x = reorder(variable, importance),
                     y = importance, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Career" = "#1f4e79",
    "Pay" = "#2e86ab",
    "Experience" = "#a8c5e0",
    "AI Attitude" = "#e67e22",  # highlight AI
    "Other" = "#cccccc"
  )) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Importance",
       title = "What Predicts Job Satisfaction?") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22, color = "#1f2a44"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14)
  )
```
